newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end 2.25 pct up on broad buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end 2.25 pct up on broad buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended 2.25 percent up on Tuesday's new accounts day as blue chips rose and speculative buying lifted second-tier stocks, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index ended 38.86 points, or 2.25 percent, up at 1,766.77 amid 275 gainers and 52 losers.
Sharp rises in second-tier stocks pulled the index up, a dealer at Fortune Securities said.
IGI jumped 10 rupees to 80, General Tyre 8.25 to 31.25, Adamjee Insurance 7.00 to 118, Sitara Chemicals 6.00 to 44 and Lucky Cement 1.60 to 15.25. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
